title: The general regularisation scheme applied to conditional density estimation
summary: The general regularisation scheme, a versatile approach for nonparametric estimation, has been successfully applied to regression, density ratio, and score estimation. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework encompassing these settings and extend it to conditional density estimation, deriving a new estimator with rigorously established convergence rates. We implement the Landweber regularisation, which is computationally more tractable than Tikhonov regularisation in this context.
